mapper.select: SELECT count(1) as num, round((count(1)/10080),4) as ratio, round((count(if(BLD.fan_status = 1, 1, null))/60),0) as fan, round((count(if(BLD.fan_status = 1 and purifier_status = 1, 1, null))/60),0) as purifier, round((count(if(BLD.fan_status = 1 and purifier_status = 1, 1, null))/60)/(count(if(BLD.fan_status = 1, 1, null))/60),4) as fanRatio, round((count(if(BLD.lampblack_data <= 1, 1, null))/60),0) as h1, round((count(if(BLD.lampblack_data >= 1.01 and BLD.lampblack_data <= 2, 1, null))/60),0) as h2, round((count(if(BLD.lampblack_data >= 2.01 and BLD.lampblack_data <= 4, 1, null))/60),0) as h3, round((count(if(BLD.lampblack_data>4, 1, null))/60),0) as h4, round((count(if(BLD.lampblack_data>1, 1, null))/60),0) as h5 FROM ${tableLampblack} BLD WHERE 1=1 and BLD.create_time between DATE_SUB(now(), interval 7 day) and DATE_SUB(now(), interval 1 day) and BLD.point_mac = #{pointMac} order by BLD.create_time DESC

SELECT count(1) as num, round((count(1)/#{numv}),4) as ratio, round((count(if(BLD.fan_status = 1, 1, null))/60),0) as fan, round((count(if(BLD.fan_status = 1 and purifier_status = 1, 1, null))/60),0) as purifier, round((count(if(BLD.fan_status = 1 and purifier_status = 1, 1, null))/60)/(count(if(BLD.fan_status = 1, 1, null))/60),4) as fanRatio, round((count(if(BLD.lampblack_data <= 1, 1, null))/60),0) as h1, round((count(if(BLD.lampblack_data >= 1.01 and BLD.lampblack_data <= 2, 1, null))/60),0) as h2, round((count(if(BLD.lampblack_data >= 2.01 and BLD.lampblack_data <= 4, 1, null))/60),0) as h3, round((count(if(BLD.lampblack_data>4, 1, null))/60),0) as h4, round((count(if(BLD.lampblack_data>1, 1, null))/60),0) as h5 FROM ${tableLampblack} BLD WHERE 1=1 and BLD.yyyymm = #{format} and BLD.point_mac = #{pointMac} order by BLD.create_time DESC

SELECT count(1) as num, round((count(1)/#{numv}),4) as ratio, round((count(if(BLD.fan_status = 1, 1, null))/60),0) as fan, round((count(if(BLD.fan_status = 1 and purifier_status = 1, 1, null))/60),0) as purifier, round((count(if(BLD.fan_status = 1 and purifier_status = 1, 1, null))/60)/(count(if(BLD.fan_status = 1, 1, null))/60),4) as fanRatio, round((count(if(BLD.lampblack_data <= 1, 1, null))/60),0) as h1, round((count(if(BLD.lampblack_data >= 1.01 and BLD.lampblack_data <= 2, 1, null))/60),0) as h2, round((count(if(BLD.lampblack_data >= 2.01 and BLD.lampblack_data <= 4, 1, null))/60),0) as h3, round((count(if(BLD.lampblack_data>4, 1, null))/60),0) as h4, round((count(if(BLD.lampblack_data>1, 1, null))/60),0) as h5 FROM ${tableLampblack} BLD WHERE 1=1 and (BLD.yyyymm = #{format1} or BLD.yyyymm = #{format2} or BLD.yyyymm = #{format3}) and BLD.point_mac = #{pointMac} order by BLD.create_time DESC

SELECT count(1) as num, round((count(1)/#{numv}),4) as ratio, round((count(if(BLD.fan_status = 1, 1, null))/60),0) as fan, round((count(if(BLD.fan_status = 1 and purifier_status = 1, 1, null))/60),0) as purifier, round((count(if(BLD.fan_status = 1 and purifier_status = 1, 1, null))/60)/(count(if(BLD.fan_status = 1, 1, null))/60),4) as fanRatio, round((count(if(BLD.lampblack_data <= 1, 1, null))/60),0) as h1, round((count(if(BLD.lampblack_data >= 1.01 and BLD.lampblack_data <= 2, 1, null))/60),0) as h2, round((count(if(BLD.lampblack_data >= 2.01 and BLD.lampblack_data <= 4, 1, null))/60),0) as h3, round((count(if(BLD.lampblack_data>4, 1, null))/60),0) as h4, round((count(if(BLD.lampblack_data>1, 1, null))/60),0) as h5 FROM ${tableLampblack} BLD WHERE 1=1 and ${sql} and BLD.point_mac = #{pointMac} order by BLD.create_time DESC
